applied.problem: It says a wrong pick shows it used the length factor once or went the wrong way, but the listed slips also include the wrong power (squared for a volume, cubed for an area) and 1000 doubled, so the description misstates its own puzzles.
"the zoom does it for any prefix" contradicts the ignores panel and the dial, which offer only cm and mm; the counting works for any prefix, but the zoom itself does not show them.
